title: Altinn Studio - Runtime ingress
description: Requests through Traefik, the ingress of every service owner's runtime cluster, to apps and to the runtime's own services. It reads Traefik's server spans, which the platform's collector forwards to Studio's collectors, through altinn-studio-traces-logsql (LogsQL), and links to the traces in altinn-studio-traces. The spans are sampled with the rest of their trace: the gateway collector keeps every trace with an error span, such as a 5xx or a 4xx an app returned, every trace over 1 s, and 10 % of the rest. So the server error, client error and slow request panels count every such request, while successful traffic is a sample whose shape follows the traffic but not its volume. Traefik sends Studio no metrics or logs yet, so there are no exact rates, latency percentiles or deploy markers. The app is the second segment of the URL path when the first is the service owner, as in /ttd/my-app/; other paths show their first segment, such as /kuberneteswrapper. Filter by environment (deployment.environment.name), service owner (altinn.service_owner, which the runtime's collector adds to everything from a service owner's cluster) and app. Datasource UIDs are pinned, matching the other Altinn Studio dashboards.

list.name: service_owner
list.label: Service owner
list.description: Service owner whose runtime cluster Traefik runs in (altinn.service_owner).

list.name: app
list.label: App
list.description: App, from the second segment of the URL path (/<service owner>/<app>/). All also includes paths that are not an app's, such as /kuberneteswrapper.

query.query: {resource_attr:service.name="traefik"} kind:2 "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name":~"^(${env:regex})$" "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner":~"^(${service_owner:regex})$" | extract_regexp "^/(?P<seg1>[^/]*)/?(?P<seg2>[^/]*)" from "span_attr:url.path" | format if (seg1:eq_field("resource_attr:altinn.service_owner") seg2:!"") "<seg2>" as app | filter app:*

list.name: filters
list.label: Filters
list.description: Filters every panel on any span field, such as span_attr:server.address or span_attr:entry_point.

panels.title: Service owners
panels.description: Service owners' runtime clusters that sent Traefik spans in the time range. A cluster that is missing has no traffic, or its platform collector does not forward Traefik's spans to Studio.

targets.expr: {resource_attr:service.name="traefik"} kind:2 "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name":~"^(${env:regex})$" "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner":~"^(${service_owner:regex})$" | extract_regexp "^/(?P<seg1>[^/]*)/?(?P<seg2>[^/]*)" from "span_attr:url.path" | format if (seg1:eq_field("resource_attr:altinn.service_owner") seg2:!"") "<seg2>" as app | format if (app:"") "/<seg1>" as app | filter app:~"^(${app:regex})$" | copy "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name" as env, "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner" as service_owner, "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as status | stats count_uniq(service_owner) clusters

panels.title: Server errors (5xx)
panels.description: Requests that Traefik answered with a 5xx in the time range, whether the app returned it or Traefik did, such as a 503 when the app has no ready pod. The gateway keeps every one of these traces, so the count is complete.

targets.expr: {resource_attr:service.name="traefik"} kind:2 "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name":~"^(${env:regex})$" "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner":~"^(${service_owner:regex})$" "span_attr:http.response.status_code":>=500 | extract_regexp "^/(?P<seg1>[^/]*)/?(?P<seg2>[^/]*)" from "span_attr:url.path" | format if (seg1:eq_field("resource_attr:altinn.service_owner") seg2:!"") "<seg2>" as app | format if (app:"") "/<seg1>" as app | filter app:~"^(${app:regex})$" | copy "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name" as env, "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner" as service_owner, "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as status | stats count() errors

panels.title: Client errors (4xx)
panels.description: Requests answered with a 4xx in the time range. Every 4xx that an app returned is counted, since Traefik's proxy span marks it as an error and the gateway keeps the trace. A 4xx that Traefik returns itself, such as a 404 for a path no app serves, is sampled like a successful request.

targets.expr: {resource_attr:service.name="traefik"} kind:2 "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name":~"^(${env:regex})$" "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner":~"^(${service_owner:regex})$" "span_attr:http.response.status_code":>=400 "span_attr:http.response.status_code":<500 | extract_regexp "^/(?P<seg1>[^/]*)/?(?P<seg2>[^/]*)" from "span_attr:url.path" | format if (seg1:eq_field("resource_attr:altinn.service_owner") seg2:!"") "<seg2>" as app | format if (app:"") "/<seg1>" as app | filter app:~"^(${app:regex})$" | copy "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name" as env, "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner" as service_owner, "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as status | stats count() errors

panels.title: Requests over 1 s
panels.description: Requests that took longer than 1 s in Traefik in the time range, from when Traefik received the request until it sent the response. The gateway keeps every trace over 1 s, so the count is complete.

targets.expr: {resource_attr:service.name="traefik"} kind:2 "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name":~"^(${env:regex})$" "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner":~"^(${service_owner:regex})$" duration:>1s | extract_regexp "^/(?P<seg1>[^/]*)/?(?P<seg2>[^/]*)" from "span_attr:url.path" | format if (seg1:eq_field("resource_attr:altinn.service_owner") seg2:!"") "<seg2>" as app | format if (app:"") "/<seg1>" as app | filter app:~"^(${app:regex})$" | copy "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name" as env, "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner" as service_owner, "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as status | stats count() slow

panels.title: Successful (sampled)
panels.description: Successful requests (status below 400) under 1 s kept in the time range. Studio's gateway collector keeps every trace with an error span or longer than 1 s, and 10 % of the rest (1 % of those that reach the kubernetes-wrapper). So this is about a tenth of the successful requests, not their number.

targets.expr: {resource_attr:service.name="traefik"} kind:2 "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name":~"^(${env:regex})$" "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner":~"^(${service_owner:regex})$" "span_attr:http.response.status_code":<400 duration:<1s | extract_regexp "^/(?P<seg1>[^/]*)/?(?P<seg2>[^/]*)" from "span_attr:url.path" | format if (seg1:eq_field("resource_attr:altinn.service_owner") seg2:!"") "<seg2>" as app | format if (app:"") "/<seg1>" as app | filter app:~"^(${app:regex})$" | copy "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name" as env, "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner" as service_owner, "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as status | stats count() requests

panels.title: Kept requests by status class
panels.description: Requests per second that the trace store kept, by status class. Studio's gateway collector keeps every trace with an error span or longer than 1 s, and 10 % of the rest (1 % of those that reach the kubernetes-wrapper). So 5xx and the 4xx that apps return are all here, while 2xx and 3xx are a sample: compare classes with each other only through the panels below. Select a series to search its traces.

targets.expr: {resource_attr:service.name="traefik"} kind:2 "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name":~"^(${env:regex})$" "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner":~"^(${service_owner:regex})$" | extract_regexp "^/(?P<seg1>[^/]*)/?(?P<seg2>[^/]*)" from "span_attr:url.path" | format if (seg1:eq_field("resource_attr:altinn.service_owner") seg2:!"") "<seg2>" as app | format if (app:"") "/<seg1>" as app | filter app:~"^(${app:regex})$" | copy "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name" as env, "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner" as service_owner, "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as status | extract_regexp "^(?P<class>[1-5])" from status | stats by (class) rate() requests

panels.title: Sampled successful requests by service owner
panels.description: Successful requests (status below 400) under 1 s per second, by environment and service owner, as kept by sampling. Studio's gateway collector keeps every trace with an error span or longer than 1 s, and 10 % of the rest (1 % of those that reach the kubernetes-wrapper). The lines follow the shape of the traffic, at about a tenth of its volume.

targets.expr: {resource_attr:service.name="traefik"} kind:2 "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name":~"^(${env:regex})$" "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner":~"^(${service_owner:regex})$" "span_attr:http.response.status_code":<400 duration:<1s | extract_regexp "^/(?P<seg1>[^/]*)/?(?P<seg2>[^/]*)" from "span_attr:url.path" | format if (seg1:eq_field("resource_attr:altinn.service_owner") seg2:!"") "<seg2>" as app | format if (app:"") "/<seg1>" as app | filter app:~"^(${app:regex})$" | copy "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name" as env, "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner" as service_owner, "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as status | stats by (env, service_owner) rate() requests

panels.title: Apps
panels.description: Requests per app over the time range, by environment and service owner: successful requests under 1 s as sampled (about a tenth of them), and every client error (4xx) an app returned, server error (5xx) and request over 1 s. The app is the second segment of the URL path when the first is the service owner, as in /ttd/my-app/. Other paths show their first segment, such as /kuberneteswrapper for the kubernetes-wrapper, whose traces are kept at 1 %, and /runtime for the gateway. Sorted by server errors; select an app to filter the dashboard by it.

targets.expr: {resource_attr:service.name="traefik"} kind:2 "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name":~"^(${env:regex})$" "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner":~"^(${service_owner:regex})$" | extract_regexp "^/(?P<seg1>[^/]*)/?(?P<seg2>[^/]*)" from "span_attr:url.path" | format if (seg1:eq_field("resource_attr:altinn.service_owner") seg2:!"") "<seg2>" as app | format if (app:"") "/<seg1>" as app | filter app:~"^(${app:regex})$" | copy "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name" as env, "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner" as service_owner, "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as status | stats by (env, service_owner, app) count() if ("span_attr:http.response.status_code":<400 duration:<1s) sampled, count() if ("span_attr:http.response.status_code":>=400 "span_attr:http.response.status_code":<500) client_errors, count() if ("span_attr:http.response.status_code":>=500) server_errors, count() if (duration:>1s) slow, max(duration) slowest

panels.title: Server errors by status code
panels.description: Requests per second that Traefik answered with a 5xx, by status code. Every one is counted. A 503 without a ReverseProxy span in its trace is Traefik's own: the app had no ready pod. A 502 or 504 is either the app's answer or Traefik failing to reach it; the trace's ReverseProxy span and the app's spans tell them apart. Select a series to search its traces.

targets.expr: {resource_attr:service.name="traefik"} kind:2 "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name":~"^(${env:regex})$" "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner":~"^(${service_owner:regex})$" "span_attr:http.response.status_code":>=500 | extract_regexp "^/(?P<seg1>[^/]*)/?(?P<seg2>[^/]*)" from "span_attr:url.path" | format if (seg1:eq_field("resource_attr:altinn.service_owner") seg2:!"") "<seg2>" as app | format if (app:"") "/<seg1>" as app | filter app:~"^(${app:regex})$" | copy "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name" as env, "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner" as service_owner, "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as status | stats by (status) rate() errors

panels.title: Recent server errors
panels.description: The latest 200 requests answered with a 5xx, from Traefik's server span. Query strings are left out. Select a trace to see whether Traefik passed the request on (its ReverseProxy span) and what the app did.

targets.expr: {resource_attr:service.name="traefik"} kind:2 "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name":~"^(${env:regex})$" "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner":~"^(${service_owner:regex})$" "span_attr:http.response.status_code":>=500 | extract_regexp "^/(?P<seg1>[^/]*)/?(?P<seg2>[^/]*)" from "span_attr:url.path" | format if (seg1:eq_field("resource_attr:altinn.service_owner") seg2:!"") "<seg2>" as app | format if (app:"") "/<seg1>" as app | filter app:~"^(${app:regex})$" | copy "resource_attr:deployment.environment.name" as env, "resource_attr:altinn.service_owner" as service_owner, "span_attr:http.response.status_code" as status | sort by (_time desc) limit 200 | fields _time, env, service_owner, app, name, status, "span_attr:server.address", "span_attr:url.path", duration, trace_id | rename trace_id as trace
